exact_statement: For finite uniform Boolean signs f,P with P=(-1)^p of GF2 degree<=d>=1, let a be full affine-input/output-character minimum influence, r the affine dimension of Fourier support(P), delta=P(f=-1), and gamma=2^(1-d)-4delta>=0. Then H(fP)-H(f)<=r, a(fP)-a(f)>=r*gamma, and for every K>=0, H(fP)-K a(fP)<=H(f)-K a(f)-r*(K*gamma-1). Thus if f is affine-influence-minimal and K*gamma>=1 it globally maximizes D_K over its joint degree<=d-phase/affine orbit; strict decrease holds for non-character phases when K*gamma>1. For cubic phases, every fixed K>4 eventually satisfies this test in the reviewed whole-product rare paid-pair arbitrary-core embedding, preserving full affine span/minimality, I tending0, SAME seed-ratio limit, original pair payment and every complete terminal. For a violating seed H0/q>K>4 these roots eventually also maximize ratio on the joint cubic/affine orbit, but their complete optimized pair reserve still satisfies S_pair,K*<-D_K(root)<0; at root ratio R it satisfies S_pair,R*<0, implying at least one smaller terminal violates R, without asserting all four do. For each fixed K>4 and epsilon>0, FEI(K) on these full-span weak-influence joint cubic/affine deficit-and-ratio extrema with one paid original pair and all proper-block expected positive terminal debts and absolute signed banks below epsilon is equivalent to full FEI(K) at SAME K. No existence of a high-K violating seed or universal constant improvement is asserted. An ACTUAL finite positive K=17/4 example uses the explicitly defined complete depth5 NAND seed on32 variables, with certified H-(17/4)I>1/8 and full-span affine minimality proved by bias and unateness; t100000000,k10000 gives dimension3200010004, global joint cubic/affine deficit and ratio extremality, a paid original pair, four fixed-K violating reset terminals, and ALL proper-block expected positive optimized-terminal debt and absolute banks below2^-9966. This is a fixed-constant obstruction, not a full FEI disproof.
